diagnostics.source_text:
let I₁ : InterleavedWord A (Fin (2 ^ (k + 1))) ι := ⋈| U₁
      have hline :
          Pr_{let r ← $ᵖ F}[
            Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation I₀ I₁ r,
              MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ (k + 1)))) ≤ e] >
            (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
        refine lt_of_le_of_lt' ?_ hR
        apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
        intro r hr
        have h := hclose ⟨r, hr⟩
        unfold jointProximityNat at h
        exact h
      have hfinal : jointProximityNat₂
          (u₀ := I₀) (u₁ := I₁) (e := e)
          (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ (k + 1)))) := by
        apply h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ (k + 1)) Nat.one_le_two_pow
        exact hline
      exact CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (MC : Set (Word A ι))
        (u := u) (e := e) hfinal
